exposure.needed: whether the environment relies on Ingresses that cert-manager creates, and how its ingress controller matches paths with pathType Exact compared with ImplementationSpecific

consequence.statement: Ingresses that cert-manager creates now use pathType Exact instead of ImplementationSpecific, so path matching by the ingress controller may work differently.
consequence.remediation: Check that your ingress controller handles Exact pathType Ingresses created by cert-manager as expected.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 changes the pathType of the Kubernetes Ingress it creates from ImplementationSpecific to Exact, so that ingress controllers handle it reliably and for better security.
